title: Moments of resistance for rectangular and T-sections

items.heading: G-1 Rectangular Sections - G-1.1 Sections Without Compression Reinforcement
G-1 Rectangular Sections - G-1.1 Sections Without Compression Reinforcement
items.text: Mu = 0.87*fy*Ast*d*(1 - Ast*fy/(b*d*fck)) when xu/d is less than the limiting value

items.heading: G-1 Rectangular Sections - G-1.1 Sections Without Compression Reinforcement
items.text: Mu_lim = 0.36*(xu_max/d)*(1 - 0.42*(xu_max/d))*b*d^2*fck when xu/d equals the limiting value

items.heading: G-1 Rectangular Sections - G-1.1 Sections Without Compression Reinforcement
items.text: if xu/d is greater than the limiting value the section should be redesigned

items.heading: G-1 Rectangular Sections - G-1.2 Section with Compression Reinforcement
items.text: Mu - Mu_lim = fsc*Asc*(d - d'); Ast = Ast1 + Ast2; Ast2 = Asc*fsc/(0.87*fy)
